summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2021-L6, a CMBS issuing entity, filed Form 8-K reporting that C-IV Asset Management LLC succeeded Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the U.S. Steel Tower loan, effective September 1, 2026. Greystone sold substantially all special servicing assets to C-IV AM, which assumed related duties under the BANK 2021-BNK34 pooling and servicing agreement. This is a routine servicing transfer notification for a securitization trust, not a special-situation corporate event.
